GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Went Forward Took hold sit 6th 5 Lengths enjoyed good trail following 1st x 2 Lengths To The Turn briefly Restricted Room Soon After Straightening Up then couldn't finish off - # run ended 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Momentarily raced in restricted room near the 400m and hampered.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well and Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths joint Lead on fence settling down, Headed at 1000m then held together much same to turn 1.5 Lengths on rail, Held Up home turn , shouldered out at 320m, kept trying but Lost Ground in Straight # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Whilst over-racing near the 900m was bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Good Pace Went Forward Settled Down 3rd Inside 3 Lengths enjoyed good trail within 1 Lengths x 500m into Clear Soon After Straightening Up challenged Leader @ 300m, dueled - # run ended 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Over raced early. Held up round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing 1.5 Lengths , Moved Up to within 0.75 Lengths turning, hit Lead 350m and got away Straightening Up , kept going to post # solid win

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , Held Up 500m-400m, came 3 Wide through the gap after straightening, kept trying to the line. Fair but never seriously looked like the winner. (Winkers FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages. Betting drifter QOP #3-90 out to $6-50. Co-trainer reported he was pleased with its overall performance which had worked well in the lead-up to the race and could add nothing to explain the lack of market support.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Raced keen early. Held up for a run from 500m until passing the 400m. Betting drifted QOP $3.9- $6.5. Co-Tnr reported pleased with the overall performance of gelding, which had worked well in the lead up to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Four Wide , Moved Up to 2 Lengths 3 Wide turning, worked up rounding turn, challenging leader as they straightened, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages. Inclined to lay in in straight. Rider reported it raced fresh after having four weeks between runs.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Inclined to lay in in the straight. RR his mount raced fresh with a gap between runs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 1 length on fence, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, cut corner, steered 2-3 Wide early in Straight and started to get wider again inside the 100m, kept coming. First start: Like to see again. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early stages.] # battled on okay
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Travelled keenly in the early stages. Shifted out under pressure passing the 100m.
